standard-dialogue.npc: Ooh, a surface-dweller! Have you got any exotic surface foods to sell?

steps.npc: A pity. Dorgeshuun food seems so dull now I've tasted surface food.
Splendid! Show me what you've got!

options.text: What kind of foods do you like?

steps.player: What kinds of food do you like?

steps.npc: All kinds! I don't want to keep eating the same food, even if I like it. I want to try new tastes!
Why not try something on me and see if I like it?

using-items-on-them-non-food.npc: That's all very well, but do you have anything edible?

using-items-on-them-disgusting-food.npc: Eww! That looks disgusting! There's no way I'm buying that.

using-items-on-them-dorgeshuun-food.npc: What's the point of selling me Dorgeshuun foods? I want to experience exotic surface cuisine!
